qs.q: A 7-year-old boy presents with pubic hair development, accelerated bone age, prepubertal testes, and markedly elevated 17-OHP. What is the diagnosis?
qs.e: Congenital Adrenal Hyperplasia (CAH) due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency causes virilization and advanced bone age due to excess adrenal androgens. The testes remain prepubertal because the androgen source is adrenal, not testicular.
